values.quote: granting the target a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds
deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow}} them for 2 seconds

mechanics.claim: The shield can be placed on an ally champion, Daisy, or Ivern himself, and explodes after 2 seconds to deal damage to nearby enemies regardless of whether the shield still holds.
mechanics.quote: The explosion occurs regardless of whether the shield is maintained.

mechanics.claim: If the seed does not damage an enemy champion and the shield persists to the end, the shield is reapplied without another explosion.
mechanics.quote: If the seed does not damage an enemy champion and the shield persists by the end of the duration, the shield is reapplied for the same strength and duration without the explosion effect.

mechanics.claim: The explosion's damage is attributed to the champion the shield was cast on, meaning it can benefit from that champion's magic penetration and trigger their spell effects instead of Ivern's.
mechanics.quote: The damage of ''Triggerseed'' is attributed to the champion the shield was cast on.

mechanics.claim: When cast on Daisy or Ivern himself, the damage is attributed to Ivern.
mechanics.quote: If cast on {{ui|Daisy}} or himself, the damage is attributed to '''Ivern'''.
